steps.1: On console.cloud.google.com, create a project (any name).
steps.3: OAuth consent screen: type “External”, add your address as a test user, then “Publish app” (otherwise the authorization expires after 7 days).
steps.4: Credentials › Create credentials › OAuth client ID › “Desktop app”, then copy the ID and the secret below.

steps.1: On portal.azure.com › Microsoft Entra ID › App registrations, create an application (personal accounts included).
steps.2: Authentication › Add a platform › “Mobile and desktop applications”, redirect URI http://127.0.0.1; turn on “Allow public client flows”.
steps.3: API permissions: add IMAP.AccessAsUser.All, SMTP.Send and offline_access (Office 365 Exchange Online).
